title: The Thousand Rak'ah Prayer
description: A guide based on the narration of Imam al-Jawad (a.s.) detailing how to distribute the recommended 1,000 units of prayer throughout the nights of Ramadan, specifically during the first twenty nights, the last ten nights, and the Nights of Qadr.

phrases.arabic: الصلاة ألف ركعة في شهر رمضان.
phrases.english: Offering one thousand units of prayer during the month of Ramadan.
phrases.transliteration: As-ṣalātu alfu rak‘atin fī shahri Ramaḍān.

phrases.english: There is a difference of opinion regarding the manner of its performance,

phrases.arabic: ولكن ما ورد في رواية عليّ ابن مهران وطائفة كبيرة من الأعلام عن الإمام الجواد عليه السلام:
phrases.english: However, that which has been transmitted in the narration of Ali ibn Mehran and a vast multitude of eminent scholars, on the authority of Imam al-Jawad (peace be upon him):
phrases.transliteration: Wa-lākin mā warada fī riwāyati ‘Aliyyi bni Mihrān wa-ṭā’ifatin kabīratin min al-a‘lām ‘an al-Imām al-Jawād ‘alayhi al-salām:

phrases.arabic: أنْ يُصَلِّي مِنْها في كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِن لَيالِي العَشْرِ الاولى والثانِيَةِ عِشْرِينَ رَكْعَةً يُسَلِّمُ بَيْنَ كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَيُصَلِّي ثَمانٍ مِنْها بَعْدَ المَغْرِبِ واثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً تُؤَخَّرُ عن صَلاةِ العِشَاءِ،
phrases.english: One should perform twenty units of prayer during each night of the first and second ten nights, offering the salutation after every two units; eight of these units are to be performed after the Sunset prayer, and twelve units are to be deferred until after the Night prayer.
phrases.transliteration: An yuṣallī minhā fī kulli laylatin min layālī al-ʿashri al-ūlā wa-th-thāniyati ʿishrīna rakʿatan yusallimu bayna kulli rakʿatayni fayuṣallī thamānin minhā baʿda al-maghribi wa-thnatā ʿashrata rakʿatan tuʾakhkharu ʿan ṣalāti al-ʿishāʾ.

phrases.arabic: وفي العَشْرِ الأخِيرَةِ يُصَلِّي مِنْها كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ ثَلاثِينَ رَكْعَةً،
phrases.english: And during the final ten nights, one performs thirty units of prayer each night.
phrases.transliteration: Wa fī al-ʿashri al-akhīrati yuṣallī minhā kulla laylatin thalāthīna rakʿatan.

phrases.arabic: يُؤتى ثَمانٌ مِنْها بَعْدَ صَلاةِ المَغْرِبِ أيْضاً ويُؤَخّر الباقِيَةَ عَنِ العِشاءِ فَيكُونُ المَجموعُ سَبْعَمائَةِ رَكْعَةً فَتَبْقى ثَلاثمائَةُ رَكْعَة.
phrases.english: Eight units thereof are also offered after the Sunset prayer, and the remainder are deferred until after the Night prayer. Thus, the total reaches seven hundred units of prayer, and three hundred units remain.
phrases.transliteration: Yu’tā thamānun minhā ba‘da ṣalāti al-maghribi ayḍan wa yu’akhkhiru al-bāqiyata ‘ani al-‘ishā’i fa-yakūnu al-majmū‘u sab‘ami’ati rak‘atan fa-tabqā thalāthumi’atu rak‘ah.

phrases.english: And it is performed during the Nights of Power.
phrases.transliteration: Wa hiya tu’addā fī layālī al-Qadri,

phrases.arabic: مائَةُ رَكْعَة لَيْلَةَ التاسِع عَشَر (بالإضافة إلى العِشْرين رَكْعَةً التي صلّاها سابقاً) ومَائَةُ رَكْعَة لَيْلَةَ الحادِي والعِشْرِين (بالإضَافَة إِلى الثّلاثِين) ومائَةُ رَكْعَةً لَيْلَة الثالِثِ والعِشْرِين (بالإضافَةِ إلى الثّلاثين رَكْعَةً) فَتَتِمُّ ألْفُ رَكْعَة»(3)
phrases.english: One hundred units of prayer on the nineteenth night (in addition to the twenty units performed previously), one hundred units on the twenty-first night (in addition to the thirty), and one hundred units on the twenty-third night (in addition to the thirty units), thus completing one thousand units.
phrases.transliteration: Mi’atu rak‘ah laylata at-tāsi‘ ‘ashar (bil-iḍāfati ilā al-‘ishrīna rak‘atan allatī ṣallāhā sābiqan) wa mi’atu rak‘ah laylata al-ḥādī wal-‘ishrīn (bil-iḍāfati ilā ath-thalāthīn) wa mi’atu rak‘atan laylata ath-thālithi wal-‘ishrīn (bil-iḍāfati ilā ath-thalāthīna rak‘atan) fatatimmu alfu rak‘ah»(3)

phrases.arabic: (ينبغي للمؤمنين أن لا يغفلوا عنها قدر المستطاع).
phrases.english: It is behoving of the believers that they should not be heedless of it to the best of their ability.
phrases.transliteration: Yanbaghī lil-mu’minīna an lā yaghfulū ‘anhā qadra al-mustatā‘.
